_om: Engelsk översättning av ai.json. Bara texter; siffrorna och AI-namnen står i den svenska filen. Personligheterna kopplas ihop med sina id:n.

ansluter: {namn} steps in through the gate in the {horn}. They look as if they have done this before.
lamnar: {namn} turns back at the gate in the {horn} and walks away. There are other towers.
ansluter_dolt: {namn} has come to the tower. They look as if they have done this before.
lamnar_dolt: {namn} turns back at the foot of the tower and walks away. There are other towers.
tar_over: {namn} seems to have fallen asleep by their lantern. Someone else now guides the steps of {namn}.
tillbaka: {namn} is back and guides their own steps again.
